formats.key: addLiquidity(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 amountADesired,uint256 amountBDesired,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Takes up to amountADesired of tokenA from the signer and sends it to the pair; the amount is at least amountAMin.
Takes up to amountBDesired of tokenB from the signer and sends it to the pair; the amount is at least amountBMin.
Mints UNI-V2 LP tokens to `to`; the pool decides how many.
Creates the pair if it does not exist yet.
formats.shown: Add up to X tokenA and up to Y tokenB as liquidity, with the two minimums, the recipient and the deadline; but the tokenA maximum has the label 'Minimum to Add'.

findings.title: addLiquidity labels the tokenA maximum (amountADesired) as 'Minimum to Add'.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json addLiquidity field {"path":"amountADesired","label":"Minimum to Add"}. UniswapV2Router02._addLiquidity uses amountADesired as the cap: `assert(amountAOptimal <= amountADesired)`. Case 0 shows 'Minimum to Add 21941.065433837393688818 CARROT' and then a second 'Minimum to Add 21392.53... CARROT'. The reader wrote that the labels look odd and it is unclear which is which.
findings.fix: Change the label of amountADesired to "Maximum to Add", the same as amountBDesired.

findings.title: addLiquidity uses the same label for different bounds of both tokens, so the signer cannot pair them.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json addLiquidity: amountAMin and amountBMin both have the label 'Minimum to Add', and amountADesired has it too. Case 0 shows 'Minimum to Add' three times.
findings.fix: Use the labels "Maximum Token A", "Maximum Token B", "Minimum Token A" and "Minimum Token B", or group each token's bounds together.

findings.title: addLiquidity does not show how many LP tokens the signer receives; the pool decides the amount.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.addLiquidity: `liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to);`. In case 0 the signer receives 0.002961077006359078 UNI-V2 and the screen shows no amount.

cases.notes: CARROT out 21941.07 matches the 'up to' amount in the interpolated intent, but its field says 'Minimum to Add'. USDC out matches. The UNI-V2 received goes to the shown recipient, but no amount is shown.

formats.key: addLiquidityETH(address token,uint256 amountTokenDesired,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Takes up to amountTokenDesired of the token from the signer and sends it to the pair; the amount is at least amountTokenMin.
Takes msg.value ETH, wraps the amount used (at least amountETHMin) to WETH and sends it to the pair.
Refunds unused ETH to the signer.
Mints UNI-V2 LP tokens to `to`.
formats.shown: Add up to X token and up to Y ETH as liquidity, with the minimums, the recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: addLiquidityETH does not show the LP amount or the ETH refund; the pool decides both.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.addLiquidityETH: `liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to);` and `if (msg.value > amountETH) TransferHelper.safeTransferETH(msg.sender, msg.value - amountETH);`

formats.key: removeLiquidity(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Takes `liquidity` LP tokens of the tokenA/tokenB pair from the signer (this uses the signer's existing allowance to the router).
Sends at least amountAMin of tokenA and at least amountBMin of tokenB to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least A tokenA and B tokenB, with the recipient and the deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETH(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Takes `liquidity` LP tokens of the token/WETH pair from the signer.
Sends at least amountTokenMin of the token and at least amountETHMin of ETH (unwrapped from WETH) to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least A token and B ETH, with the recipient and the deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Takes `liquidity` LP tokens of the token/WETH pair from the signer.
Sends the router's token balance to `to`. The check against amountTokenMin happens before the token fee, so `to` may receive less.
Sends at least amountETHMin of ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least B ETH and A token before token fees, with the recipient and the deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHWithPermit(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: Uses the signer's LP permit to approve the router, for `liquidity` or for unlimited when approveMax is true; an unlimited allowance stays in place after the call.
Takes `liquidity` LP tokens from the signer.
Sends at least amountTokenMin of the token and at least amountETHMin of ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least A token and B ETH, with the recipient, the deadline and the LP approval as 'Unlimited to router' or 'This removal only'.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHWithPermitSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: Uses the signer's LP permit to approve the router, for `liquidity` or for unlimited when approveMax is true.
Takes `liquidity` LP tokens from the signer.
Sends the token, checked against amountTokenMin before the fee, and at least amountETHMin of ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least B ETH and A token before token fees, with the recipient, the deadline and the LP approval enum.

formats.key: removeLiquidityWithPermit(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)

formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least A tokenA and B tokenB, with the recipient, the deadline and the LP approval enum.
